idea-plugin.name: KnobDeck Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Lets the KnobDeck dial and deck control your JetBrains IDE: Run and Debug (by configuration name), stepping, Search Everywhere, the terminal, and any IDE action by its ID.

Works with IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider, CLion and the other IntelliJ-based IDEs.

Setup

  1. Install this plugin. It starts a small action server on 127.0.0.1:21420.
  2. Optional: set a password in Settings → Tools → KnobDeck.
  3. In KnobDeck, install the IntelliJ IDE plugin and enter the same port and password in its setup.

Use Tools → KnobDeck: Copy an Action ID to find IDs for KnobDeck's "Customized Action" button.

The server only accepts connections from this computer and refuses requests from web pages. The plugin sends no data anywhere.

action.description: Find an IDE action ID for KnobDeck's Customized Action button
